limits: Judgments use only the three frozen allowed inputs; no source links, identities, native category answers, peer outputs or external evidence were accessed.
No product identity was recognized with sufficient specificity to report; no prior product classification was used.

All 93 ordered primary ingredient ranks were considered with their exact admitted functions. Unassessed functions remain unassessed and are neither treated as negligible nor promoted to conditioning-film evidence.
Rank supplied declaration order only. No concentration, grade, film load, wash count, sensory weight or distribution target was inferred.
The P05 organic-production declaration was considered separately as a descriptive annotation, not an ingredient or persistence mechanism.
These are committed whole-formula qualitative decisions for the stated application contexts, not measurements of washout or repeated-use accumulation.

The first combined tool display was truncated; the complete blind packet and complete function dictionary were subsequently displayed separately before decisions. The method and its complete output/read contract were visible in the initial display.
Output schemas and references were validated in memory before serialization; output files were not reread because the read scope permits only the three input paths.
